description: This Java source file defines the ShardRegionFactory class which is responsible for creating and managing Akka cluster sharding regions for different services within the Eclipse Ditto project. It provides methods to obtain shard regions for things, policies, and search updaters, utilizing Akka's cluster sharding components.

classes.name: ShardRegionFactory
classes.description: A factory class for creating Akka cluster sharding regions for various services like things, policies, and search updaters.

methods.name: getInstance
methods.description: Factory method to create a ShardRegionFactory instance given an ActorSystem. Checks for null argument.

methods.name: getThingsShardRegion
methods.description: Creates and returns a shard region for 'things' service.

methods.name: getPoliciesShardRegion
methods.description: Creates and returns a shard region for 'policies' service.

methods.name: createShardRegion
methods.description: Internal helper method to instantiate a shard region proxy with given parameters.

methods.name: getSearchUpdaterShardRegion
methods.description: Creates and returns a shard region for search updater service with specified actor Props and cluster role.
